title: Doraemon: Nobita to Fukkatsu no Hoshi
native_title: ドラえもん ～のび太と復活の星～
overview:
Save the distant planet from crisis!

An action game packed with all the charm of the eternal idol "Doraemon"!

Based on the Doraemon anime, this platform adventure sends Doraemon and Nobita off to rescue a faraway planet. Run, jump and dash through textured stages built in layers, hopping between the foreground and background planes. Equip Doraemon's secret gadgets in two slots and put them to use - the gadgets you pick change the story scenes and action stages that follow. Between stages, the story plays out in voiced event scenes featuring the voice cast of the TV anime, with more than 60 minutes of dialogue.

- Single player
- Memory backup save

遠い星の危機を救え！

永遠のアイドル“ドラえもん”の魅力がたっぷりつまったアクションゲーム！
